posting.title: Lead Data Scientist
posting.description:
About the role:
Baltic Analytics ApS builds supply-chain optimization software for manufacturers across the Baltic Sea region. We are hiring a Lead Data Scientist to own our optimization and forecasting model stack.

Responsibilities:
You will design and productionize ML pipelines for demand forecasting and route optimization using Python, SQL, AWS, and Spark. You will mentor two data scientists and set technical direction.

Requirements:
5+ years of experience in data science or applied ML, including some team-leadership experience, is required. Strong hands-on experience with Python (scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas), SQL, AWS, and Spark is required.

Location and work mode:
Our office is in Aarhus, but this role can be worked primarily remotely with occasional travel to the Aarhus office (roughly once a month) — most of the team already works this way, including colleagues based in Copenhagen.

What we offer:
Competitive salary, a home-office budget, and a flexible schedule.
